expected_symptom: Internal compiler failure when -fspv-debug=vulkan-with-source is added to the otherwise successful SPIR-V compile.
summary: The complete ray-query debug-info repro fails through v1.8.2505.1 and compiles from stable v1.9.2602 onward; the fix was measured at commit 61de7411f, whose parent b0245e32f still fails the filed command.
title: [SPIR-V] Failed to compile ray query shader with  -fspv-debug=vulkan-with-source
